notes: Judged on macro mass distribution, which is what the blockout pass owns. All 8 macro assemblies are present, attached and correctly placed: hull spine, forward-swept wing, aft tail blade, dorsal mast fin with integral fairing, mid stabiliser fin, ventral keel fin, ventral pod cradle, stern drive bay. Proportions measured against the reference rather than eyeballed: silhouette aspect 2.66 vs 2.68; mast fin height 0.207x length vs 0.207; fin root at 30% of length vs 30%; hull thickness 0.35 measured from the reference deck-to-ventral line. Camera solved by IoU sweep (pitch 16, yaw 6) rather than guessed. Silhouette IoU 0.627 against the star-free reference, up from 0.198 at first render. The residual is entirely missing meso/micro detail - pod bulges, radiator vanes, deck plates, mast machinery - none of which exists at blockout by design. Weakness carried forward: forward-wing half-span sits on a flat optimum between 2.2 and 2.7, so span remains weakly constrained by this single view, as flagged in the spec's planform unknown.
